interface.longDescription: DEPOT Bridge by Mohammed Mansour for Qumi Teknolojis, trading name of QROO Inc. (https://qumi.app; https://qr-oo.com; support@qr-oo.com). Installable by Codex/Claude and Depot-hosted agents. Ships a zero-dependency local MCP server to expose CLI detection, SHA-256 verified Depot CLI installation into user or project scope, discovery of all supported CLI subcommands, guarded execution, build SDK operations when separately installed, and optional operator-configured upstream MCP. Secrets must never be entered in chat or MCP form mode. The operator-only hidden terminal encrypts tokens with AES-256-GCM and a passphrase; an unlocked agent process can use them in memory, including GIT_ASKPASS. Rotation produces a non-secret encrypted-ciphertext fingerprint receipt optionally committed to Git. Windows DPAPI remains supported. A ChatGPT web connection requires a separately hosted verified HTTPS MCP endpoint; packaging alone does not deploy one. Secure per-user credential questions use URL-mode MCP elicitation or a localhost browser fallback on Windows, Linux and macOS. The browser encrypts answers with RSA-OAEP/AES-GCM before local submission; the bridge stores AES-256-GCM ciphertext outside Git. No plaintext secret is collected through agent chat. Remote/cloud agents require an approved HTTPS credential portal or platform secret manager; URL question styling is controlled by the client.

name: depot-bridge
